restart.frontendReady: ARMED only after real accepted request
restart.producerReady: APPLIED only after actual World-only COMPLETE, before ordinary App UI reconnect
restart.afterObservation: fresh current pair memberships + same replacement generation

ticket.hook: Root private executed genuine already-consumed App-ticket probe only
ticket.testFixtures: TEST ONLY, never actual capability evidence
ticket.routing: One Root direct worldOrigin connection with actual frontend Origin, counted with at most three foreground-group relay connections: total <=4. Relay active cap stays2.

failure: Bounded signal/expiry checks; uncertain operation retires with fixed error, no retry or secret diagnostic. Root retains every actual handle and cleanup duty.
durableOutput: Fixed action/state/count summaries; no raw backend generations, user/room/process identity, credential, payload or descriptor.
now: Nondecreasing epoch milliseconds (default Date.now), separate from relay monotonic frame times.
